withdrawn_because: Applied to the 36 pilot episodes on 2026-09-02 and failed. Asking an LLM judge whether a score-maximisation game's objective was achieved forced it onto a structural proxy: the verdict matched the terminated flag alone in 33/36 episodes, it produced 14 SUCCESS / 0 FAILURE / 22 UNKNOWN leaving ExpeL no contrast and ReasoningBank no pitfalls, and it ran anti-correlated with play quality (tetris episodes that terminated had median score 128 against 220 for those that survived, yet every terminated episode was labelled SUCCESS). Evidence retained at runs/cross_domain_memory_pilot_v0_provisional/source_labelled_v1_WITHDRAWN.json.
claim: One shared outcome resolution for every cross-domain memory method

official_predicate_availability.note: None of the six source games emit an official_success field. Every exported episode resolves to UNKNOWN at the OFFICIAL stage and falls through.

tetris.justification: Score accumulates continuously and no line-clear target is declared by the benchmark, so any threshold would be invented here rather than defined by the game.

candy_crush.justification: The collected episodes carry no level-objective field, so a win condition cannot be read off the record.

gymv_columns.justification: Endless mode with no declared target score; termination is stack-out, which the judge can read but a fixed predicate cannot grade.

gymv_streets_of_rage_2.justification: Stage completion is not recorded as a structured field; only score and termination are available.

gymv_strider.justification: Stage completion is not recorded as a structured field; only score and termination are available.

gymv_thunder_force_iii.justification: Stage completion is not recorded as a structured field; only score and termination are available.

shared_evaluator.fidelity_note: ReasoningBank natively runs a judge; ExpeL and AWM do not. The main experiment gives all methods these shared labels so no method holds supervision the others were denied. Appendix arms re-run ExpeL and AWM under native fidelity, where the absence of environment-reported success leaves AWM with an empty workflow bank; that outcome is reported, not repaired.

preregistered_empty_bank_rule.trigger: A method resolves to fewer than 1 eligible source episode
preregistered_empty_bank_rule.action: induce_memory_artifact raises InsufficientEligibleSourceError and the arm is reported as empty rather than rescued by lowering the threshold
